description: This Java class 'QuestionService' provides CRUD operations for managing questions and answers within a Spring application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting questions and their associated answers.

classes.name: QuestionService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations for Questions and Answers, managing data persistence via repositories, with transaction management and exception handling.

methods.name: listQuestions
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of all questions.

methods.name: getQuestionOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a question by ID or throws ResourceNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Creates and saves a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Updates the title and content of an existing question identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Deletes a question by ID if it exists, otherwise throws ResourceNotFoundException.

methods.name: listAnswers
methods.description: Lists all answers associated with a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Associates a new answer with a specified question and saves it.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Deletes an answer associated with a question after validation.
